name: TOTP Sign-In Flow Integration Proof
summary: Registers real-path proof that TOTP can complete sign-in only when bound to a password-issued MFA challenge, then adapts the accepted proof to browser session or mobile token completion.
notes: AppUserMfaManager is never mocked. Both browser and mobile proofs execute its real TOTP verification and replay-protection logic.
IMfaChallengeStore is treated as an infrastructure seam; the real typed handler is responsible for challenge validation, user/provider binding and consumption ordering.
The browser-session proof uses the real LagoVista SignInManager. Persistence, secure storage, redirect resolution and the ASP.NET Identity adapter remain infrastructure/framework seams.
The mobile adapter proof mocks IAuthTokenManager only after real challenge-bound TOTP proof has succeeded.
Runtime execution evidence remains separate from this authored proof binding.

sourceReferences.note: Challenge-required TOTP success/rejection proof and mobile token-adapter evidence source.
Real challenge-bound TOTP handler under proof.
Real TOTP verification, replay protection and MFA freshness behavior under proof.
